about: Places in a saved franchise that hold wording as a finished sentence (it keeps the language it was written in). Recorded by tests/text-never-decides.test.js from one season. News and League News are saved lines (src/text/index.js) and follow the language; what is listed for them here is only the fragments inside a line that are still plain text. Do not add a place to make the test pass: save a line (line / lineParts) instead, or ask the owner.
